entities.summary: Uzbek Shaybanid, a notable figure in the history of Tajikistan, associated with Bukharan and Kokand Khanate Period (1500–1740). Preceded by Shaybanid Bukhara and Tajik Culture. Their legacy influenced Emirate of Bukhara and Pamir Autonomy and Manghit.
